question: List all courses with their fees
Which course has the highest fees?
sql: SELECT course_name, fees FROM college.course ORDER BY fees DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show each student's name with the course they are enrolled in
sql: SELECT si.name, c.course_name FROM college.student_info AS si JOIN college.course AS c ON c.student_id = si.student_id

question: Total fees collected from students in each city
sql: SELECT si.city, SUM(c.fees) AS total_fees FROM college.student_info AS si JOIN college.course AS c ON c.student_id = si.student_id GROUP BY si.city ORDER BY total_fees DESC

question: How many students are there in each city?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS students FROM college.student_info GROUP BY city ORDER BY students DESC

question: Average marks for each grade
sql: SELECT grade, AVG(marks) AS avg_marks FROM college.student2 GROUP BY grade ORDER BY grade

question: Top 3 students by marks
sql: SELECT name, marks FROM college.student2 ORDER BY marks DESC LIMIT 3

question: Students who scored more than the average marks
sql: SELECT name, marks FROM college.student2 WHERE marks > (SELECT AVG(marks) FROM college.student2)

question: Average salary by gender
sql: SELECT gender, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM test.users GROUP BY gender

question: How many users signed up each month?
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM test.users GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Users born after the year 1995
sql: SELECT name, date_of_birth FROM test.users WHERE date_of_birth >= '1996-01-01' ORDER BY date_of_birth
